claim: Parking at Lumen Field on Gameday : r/SoundersFC - Reddit
summary: For Sounders matches, the Lumen Field garage is available. Parking is usually between $35 - $50. You may be able to find street parking on First Ave for cheap/free. As someone else stated, spot hero is also a good place to look. One other option is to take the light rail in from any of the stops and get off at either chinatown or stadium.
